moves.text: Saturn moves from Meena into Mesha.
moves.until_text: Saturn stays in Mesha until 20 October 2027, when it moves into Meena.

moves.text: Saturn leaves your 11th house and enters your 12th house.
moves.from_theme: The 11th house is about gains and friends.
moves.to_theme: The 12th house is about rest, spending and faraway places.

others.text: Jupiter stays in Kataka, your 3rd house.
Rahu stays in Makara, your 9th house.
Ketu stays in Kataka, your 3rd house.

moon_notes: Erashtaka begins: Saturn enters the 12th, 1st or 2nd sign from the Moon.
